notes.title: Version 1.5 — Bounty Killers
notes.notes:
[p]Howdy, y’all. Tapkeeper here along with the team at DEAD MAN’S HAND Saloon bringin’ you exciting news straight from the Wild Frontier.[/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44918709/4591404c25ea2752735560c300cfb6fb1d63ab7c.png"][/img][/h2][h1]Bounty Killers - DMH Patch 1.5.0[/h1][p]
New changes to the bounty system bring a whole new layer of gameplay to the DEAD MAN'S HAND experience.[/p][h2]The Bounty Board[/h2][p]Players of DEAD MAN'S HAND may have noticed some handful of times the option to place a bounty on a player that eliminated you from the game. In the earlier versions of the title, the system had slightly more functionality, but ultimately was adjusted due to limitations at the time. Because of this, the feature was largely underutilized, making that large bounty board space beside the HOLDER portrait rather vacant.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44918709/47a2c42b9c331cb76e9eecd4fe26dfe1b217e62b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In this latest update, the bounty system now returns more powerful than ever. At any time during a match, players may click on the small icon next to the chat tabs to create a new bounty. This means you can place bounties not only to seek revenge, but also to influence another player during normal gameplay.[/p][h3]Persistent Bounties[/h3][p]The bounty system is far more robust than before, offering players a chance to become Most Wanted in the entire saloon with bounties that roll over between matches. As players continue to place additional FC bounties on the same player, the running total will continue to accumulate, resulting in an even larger payout when they are finally eliminated.[/p][p][i]Please note that flavor text for bounties will not carry over between matches.[/i][/p][p][/p][h2]Quick Match Lobbies[/h2][p]One of the biggest struggles players face in DEAD MAN'S HAND is finding a match using our Quick Match service. To remedy this, we've implemented a new system that is sure to help amend the heartache of silent solitude. [/p][p]From now on, when joining a Quick Match, you'll be sorted into a server-controlled lobby. From here, you can chat with other players in the queue and, if you all ready up, begin the game with less than four players! If you prefer to wait, the game will automatically begin once all four slots are filled.[/p][p]We hope this new change to the matchmaking systems will make finding random lobbies a smoother experience. As a reminder, players receive double payouts when using the Quick Match service to find a game. While we began rolling out this new feature in our previous patch, we are now formally announcing it with the addition of our new Spectator Mode![/p][p][/p][h2]Spectator Mode[/h2][p]For those who want to sit out of the action and observe a match instead, SPECTATOR mode has been added to the game! While in the lobby, players can denote themselves as a spectator, allowing for casual viewing of a match.[/p][p]Additionally, players who join a lobby while a game is in progress will be able to observe the game directly, rather than waiting for all players to return from their current match.[/p][p][/p][h2]HOLDER & TARGET View[/h2][p]In earlier versions of DEAD MAN'S HAND, players could clearly see who the HOLDER was currently aiming at. This functionality was lost as we introduced the new targeting interface. As of Patch 1.5, all players will now see a crosshair at the top of the screen indicate which player is currently being aimed at.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44918709/4f060d26a9aa70542b50e4362bff61f9e7b46f39.png"][/img][/p][p]That’s all for this edition of Wild Frontier news. Until next time, this is the staff at the DEAD MAN’S HAND Saloon signing off![/p][p][/p][h3]Itemized Patch Notes[/h3][list][*][p]bounty panel can now be accessed and used at any time[/p][/*][*][p]persistent bounties that can accrue (these do not include the text seen in the match they were posted).[/p][/*][*][p]new quickplay lobbies, begins when all players are ready or as soon as all 4 players are present. after the match, players are returned to the lobby and the next game will start when everyone is ready or automatically in 30 seconds if the lobby is full.[/p][/*][*][p]all players can now see who the HOLDER is aiming at before firing.[/p][/*][*][p]spectating, can mark self as spectator before the game starts or press SPECTATE while a game is in progress to join mid-match[/p][/*][*][p]lobby monitor now features the name of the lobby at the top[/p][/*][*][p]fixed bounty poster sfx not being affected by sfx volume[/p][/*][*][p]fixed inability to post bounties[/p][/*][*][p]fixed missing button graphics when using a controller[/p][/*][*][p]fixed player join noise not obeying SFX volume setting[/p][/*][*][p]fixed an issue with many queued game cutscenes still running in the background after leaving a match.[/p][/*][/list][h2][/h2]

notes.title: DEAD MAN'S HAND: Card Roulette Anniversary Update & Celebration 2025
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44918709/93e35cd50f2b43a9d8624aed64489fa1c5c60914.png[/img]

Howdy, y’all. Tapkeeper here along with the team at DEAD MAN’S HAND Saloon bringin’ you exciting news straight from the Wild Frontier.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44918709/4591404c25ea2752735560c300cfb6fb1d63ab7c.png[/img]

[h1]Card Roulette Anniversary 2025
[/h1]
My, my, how time flies! It's time to celebrate the one year anniversary of DEAD MAN'S HAND: Card Roulette Action!

Daily Log-in rewards are raised to 30 FC during the event, and as an added bonus, players can enter the special code YEARONE to get an extra serving of 350 Frontier Credits!

The Card Roulette Anniversary event will run from April 9th thru April 23rd, so be sure to pay us a visit get your exclusive bonuses while they last!

As part of the celebration, we're also rolling out a special set of "Sepia" customization options, modeled after the picturesque sepiatone photographs of a bygone era. Unlike with our other seasonal exclusives, these will remain unlockable even after the conclusion of the event.

[h1]Main Menu Updates[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44918709/8ee063b8c88ee49741cd46ce2e11a59246242415.png[/img]

Quality of life changes are part of the fun for this Card Roulette Anniversary! A series of new buttons have been added, with customization tied to your preview window in the top left corner.

Below that, the News, Discord, and Gift Code buttons help clear up some of the previously occupied space across the home screen. Be sure to let us know what you think of these changes.

Keen-eyed viewers may also notice there's one additional button now has joined the party under the PLAY tab...

[h1]Single Player — Arcade Mode[/h1]
As part of the one year anniversary update, we are excited to reveal a brand new single-player game type is coming to the DEAD MAN'S HAND Saloon!

Launching April 16, players can step into our first arcade feature— a special endless [b]Survival Mode[/b] that pits them against a brand new model of Frontier Unit. Endure an endless game of DEAD MAN'S HAND that only stops when the player has finally been eliminated.

As part of this new mode, the fine folks at the DEAD MAN'S HAND Saloon will also be rolling out global leaderboards in a later update. Stay tuned for more information to come.

As for who players will be facing in Survival Mode...

[h1]Introducing the Exterminator Unit[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44918709/d72f5d9a4cd831044287728d88534088ad4b3903.png[/img]

Exterminator units are seasoned Bounty-Killers whose talents allow them to track down and eliminate fugitives all across the Wild Frontier. They are of few words, recognized as harbingers of the end for any soul unfortunate enough to be added to their lists. The HEAVEN CORPORATION is proud to provide these capable machines wherever necessary to ensure the continued security and safety of pioneers and settlers of the Wild Frontier.

HEAVEN CORPORATION Exterminator Units are relentless agents of justice who will not quit until their target is destroyed. With such fierce determination, we're certain their talents will be made known far and wide thanks to their new exhibition in the upcoming DEAD MAN'S HAND Saloon Survival Mode!

Of course, if you want the Exterminator Unit to join your roster of playable units, you'll have to earn it.

[h1]Event Unlockables List[/h1]
[list]
[*] Saloongirl Color Palette “Sepia” Added | 150 FC
[*] Lawman Color Palette “Sepia” Added | 150 FC
[*] Missus Color Palette “Sepia” Added | 150 FC
[*] Undertaker Color Palette “Sepia” Added | 150 FC
[*] Frontier Unit Color “Sepia” Added | 300 FC
[*] Hair Color “Sepia” Added | 300 FC
[*] LED Color “Sepia” Added | 250 FC
[*] Sepia ? Trigger Flair | 250 FC
[*] Playable Character "Exterminator Unit" | ???
[/list]
[i]Please note these unlockables will remain available after the conclusion of the event.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44918709/4f060d26a9aa70542b50e4362bff61f9e7b46f39.png[/img]

That’s all for this edition of Wild Frontier news. Until next time, this is the staff at the DEAD MAN’S HAND Saloon signing off!

notes.title: On the House - 1.3.0 Update
notes.notes:
Howdy, y’all. Tapkeeper here along with the team at DEAD MAN’S HAND Saloon bringin’ you exciting news straight from the Wild Frontier.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44918709/4591404c25ea2752735560c300cfb6fb1d63ab7c.png[/img]

[h1]On the House - DMH Patch 1.3.0[/h1]

Patch 1.3 brings a massive change to the DEAD MAN’S HAND Saloon’s multiplayer offerings and where to play.

[h2]Account Creation Expanded — DMH Saloon Membership[/h2]
As part of Patch 1.3, we are now enabling users to create their own user accounts within the DEAD MAN’S HAND Saloon that will allow them to log in and maintain progress across multiple platforms. 

With those words in mind, you may be wondering what sort of platforms we might be talking about…

[h2]Web Browser & Smart Phone Compatibility[/h2]
We are pleased to announce that players can now access the game via web browser on both desktop and mobile. That’s right, you can now play DEAD MAN’S HAND on your phones and mobile devices!

Visit our website cardrouletteaction.com to play! Make sure to set up your DMH Saloon Membership Card so that your progress will be saved.

[h2]Lobby Codes[/h2]
Custom sessions will now generate lobby codes that can be used to connect to the lobby directly from the main menu.

[h2]Friends Can Play for Free![/h2]
Launching with the release of Patch 1.3 is a big change for those who want to play with friends who don’t yet own their own copy of the game— Guest Player Slots! When creating new lobbies, players may also share the lobby code with up to three guest players.

Guest players who do not own their own copy of DEAD MAN’S HAND: Card Roulette Action can launch the demo on Steam or visit the game’s itch.io page and join in via web browser by using the lobby code. Please be advised that unless a player who owns a copy of the game hosts a lobby and shares the lobby code, only practice mode will be available to guest users.

Once again, guest players will be capped at 3 per lobby. Please note that player data, including customization and Frontier Credits, will not be saved after the conclusion of the game session. Lobbies will be terminated once all paid users have left the session.

[h3]Turn Start Voice Lines Added[/h3]
New voice lines have been added to notify players when it is the start of their turn as the Holder.

[h3]News Button Added to Main Menu[/h3]
A News button has been added to the main menu. Clicking it will bring up a new window featuring information related to the latest news and updates for DEAD MAN’S HAND: Card Roulette Action.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44918709/4f060d26a9aa70542b50e4362bff61f9e7b46f39.png[/img]

notes.title: Paying the Tab - Patch 1.2.0 Release!
notes.notes:
Howdy, y’all! Tapkeeper here along with the team at DEAD MAN’S HAND Saloon bringin’ you exciting news straight from the Wild Frontier.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44918709/4591404c25ea2752735560c300cfb6fb1d63ab7c.png[/img]

[h1]Paying the Tab — Patch 1.2.0 is Live![/h1]

The latest patch for DEAD MAN’S HAND: Card Roulette Action is rolling into town. We’ve got a long list of exciting new changes to introduce, so pull up a seat and have a look-see.

[h3]New Animations & UI / UX Improvements[/h3]

The biggest change coming in Patch 1.2 is an overhaul to the game’s presentation and interface. 
To help speed up the flow of gameplay, a player’s splash screen will now only play once per turn. We have also made significant changes to the gameplay screen, as shown below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44918709/df76b47d4d0488ea3b1459641f8053be92bfbc31.jpg[/img]
The goal with these changes is to make the gameplay elements easier to understand, as well as more visually pleasing to look at.

Previously, players would cycle through the list of opponents when selecting their TARGET. Now, a new AIM button will bring down a lineup of the players in a new selection window. The players’ custom TRIGGER flair will also appear in these sequences if they have an Active card in the slot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44918709/fb5764f2c23dff95ccbf194c5ab0287f9a735122.jpg[/img]
Additionally, players will notice new animations have been added for the SPIN and RELOAD cards. These will play as the cards are used.

Finally, when aiming at their own character, new animations for the trigger pull sequence will play. Changes have also been made to the visual elements behind the characters during these scenes. We hope you will enjoy them.

[h3]Custom Cursor & Controller Support[/h3]
The title now features a custom cursor shaped like the hands of the Frontier Units. This cursor’s appearance will reflect the color changes made to the units in the customization window.

Additionally, the title now also features gamepad support with a simulated cursor controlled with user input.

[b][h3]Bounty Window Updates[/h3][/b]
As part of the updates to the user experience, a bounty window will now appear after a player is eliminated, asking if they would like to place a bounty on the player who eliminated them. The bounty window will also now remain active even during cutscenes, allowing players to continue interaction until their bounty is placed.

As part of the 1.2 UI overhaul, the bounty board has been repositioned in the new game UI layout and will now properly remove bounties that have been claimed.

[b][h3]Chat & Options Window Updates[/h3][/b]
As of Patch 1.2, the in-game chat and options windows will remain interactive above cutscenes. Players may still cycle between chat messages and system messages.

[h3]FC Tabs & Increased Payouts[/h3]
One of the big changes coming to the game is increased payouts for players coming out of each match. In the original release of DEAD MAN’S HAND, winners of a game would receive 5 FC per total player in the game, and every player received 1 FC per turn survived.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44918709/88e7c7384c59fefb715ead5d3f35aa8f1581bbf9.jpg[/img]
In Patch 1.2, players will now receive FC for a myriad of reasons, with the total payout tabulated at the end of the game or when they are eliminated. Some of the new ways to earn FC include:
[list]
[*] Choosing yourself as the TARGET
[*] Eliminating other players[/list]
As you play each game, take a close look at your payout screen to find out exactly what earned you your winnings.

[h3]New Cards Added
[/h3]Two additional cards have been added to the game. They will appear in standard play as of Patch 1.2.

[b]LAWSUIT[/b] - TRIGGER - Receive HOLDER’s hand when you are chosen as their TARGET.
[b]INHERIT[/b] - TRIGGER -  Receive TARGET’s hand when they are eliminated by your bullet.

[h3]New Color Palettes Added
[/h3]Additional color options have been added to the customization screen.

[h3]Code Redemption Added[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44918709/a8be17069c8471dbdb2d2dcc9c62acca8f7b286e.jpg[/img]
A new window for Code Redemption has been added to the main menu. Patrons may now enter a code in this window to receive special promotional bonuses and rewards.

As a thank you for reading this update and so that you might test this new feature out, enter the code [b]PAYOUT[/b] in the redemption window to receive 500 FC, courtesy of the HEAVEN CORPORATION.

Please keep in mind that some codes may only be available for a limited time. Stay tuned for additional codes in the future.

[h3]Feedback Form Update[/h3]
The in-game feedback form now has word-wrap enabled, making it easier to submit reports.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44918709/4f060d26a9aa70542b50e4362bff61f9e7b46f39.png[/img]


That’s all for this edition of Wild Frontier news. You can find an itemized summary of all the 1.2.0 patch notes below. Until next time, this is the staff at the DEAD MAN’S HAND Saloon signing off!

[list]
[*] Chat and options menus are now interactable above cutscenes.
[*] Bounty window comes up after you die asking if you want to place a bounty on your killer
[*] Bounty window remains interactive between cutscenes
[*] Fixed bounty posters not being removed when completed.
[*] New scoring system for winning credits per match based on performance.
[*] New match score receipt shown at end of round
[*] Updated text on spin and reload cards (chamber > cylinder).
[*] New trigger cards: acitve_inherit and active_lawsuit.
[*] New in-game mouse cursor + controller can move the cursor

[*] Faster turn transition, only show splash once per player per game.
[*] Fixed lawsuit and avarice giving or taking cards too early in the turn sequence.
[*] Ready button now reflects the local player’s ready state.
[*] Added more palettes for each character
[*] Fixed tooltips not showing for the active trigger card.
[*] New hand shooting animation
[*] Added alternate death animations when a player has shot themselves.
[*] Enabled word wrap for feedback form
[/list]

notes.title: Feature Update 1 - 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Howdy, y’all. Tapkeeper here along with the team at DEAD MAN’S HAND Saloon bringin’ you exciting news straight from the Wild Frontier.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44918709/4591404c25ea2752735560c300cfb6fb1d63ab7c.png[/img]

[h1]Color the Wild Frontier - Patch 1.1.0 is Live! [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44918709/f03e45b09cec270025fd219956d354f77161d314.png[/img]
The Colorful Frontier Update has officially gone live! With this new patch, patrons will be able to change the colors of their frontier units in myriad new ways, from the color of their outfits to the hues of their hair and metal finish.

New colors can be unlocked with the use of Frontier Credits, which are earned by playing the game. Players can access these new colors through the CUSTOMIZE button on the main menu. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44918709/b9ac3145ef78ade1b136c3d05ccb194ba4da862c.png[/img]

Once you’ve selected your desired colors, just pay your tab and the colors are yours. To preview a color, simply select it from the drop down menu of each category. Once you’ve made a selection, you can finalize your purchase.

In addition to new colors, players can also select a custom visual flair that appears when a Trigger Card is placed. These can be accessed within the Holder View. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44918709/db12d4834340fb3f6e9eb9eeda1dc63a48ed9b8f.png[/img]

Pricing for each new customization option varies, so be sure to save up those credits!

[h2]Frontier Pioneer Bonus[/h2]
As a special thank you to all players who stepped into the DEAD MAN’S HAND Saloon before the launch of Patch 1.1.0, we are crediting each of your accounts with a bonus color palette for each of the existing Frontier Units. Just where have we seen these familiar shades before…?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44918709/92dcde9216a31b79f1539384581a6ac468cacbf2.png[/img]
In addition to being unlocked automatically at no cost for our faithful patrons, the Frontier Pioneer set is also a timed exclusive! Stay tuned for further updates to learn when these limited edition colors will be made available to new patrons.

[h1]NEW WAYS TO PLAY[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44918709/da8afdc1181bab02f6e0195e6c58baadbe8a1f6e.png[/img]
[h2]Hydra[/h2]
[i]As one head is blown off another will takes it's place.[/i]
In [b]Hydra[/b] mode you can get shot up to 3 times before being eliminated. Use this time to build up a formidable hand and execute your deadly strategy.
[color=Lightsteelblue]This modifier is highly recommended for 1v1s.[/color]

[h2]Speed Loader[/h2]
WIth [b]Speed Loader[/b] enabled, every 3 rounds that passes adds another bullet to the starting count. This effect is permanent and stacks until the gun is fully loaded by round 15. 
[color=Lightsteelblue]Use this modifier to speed up matches or make the match much more dangerous.[/color]

[h2]Randomizer[/h2]
For the ultimate thrill seeker: all cards dealt are either Mystery or Random trigger cards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44918709/705d40b4ccf4631b92503605f7d134bd37879b22.png[/img]

[h3]All of these modes may be combined and are also compatible with [b]Multicard[/b] mode[/h3]

[h1]Player Customization[/h1]
You can now mix and match your choice of colors for your: clothes, hair, eyes, and exterior. Additionally you can change the special effect that plays when you play a trigger card face down.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44918709/78a0c14dcc928b9753f196c0e3a33199a5921d58.png[/img]

[h2]Celebration Sale — Purchase DMH at 20% Off for a Limited Time![/h2]
As part of the Steam Summer Sale, we’re happy to announce that more and more patrons will be able to hop into the DEAD MAN’S HAND Saloon at a discounted rate of 20% off! Whether you were waiting to purchase the title for yourself or would like to buy it as a gift for others, we’d love to see new faces in the DEAD MAN’S HAND Saloon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44918709/4f060d26a9aa70542b50e4362bff61f9e7b46f39.png[/img]

That’s all for this edition of Wild Frontier news. You can find an itemized summary of all the 1.1.0 patch notes below. Until next time, this is the staff at the DEAD MAN’S HAND Saloon signing off!

[h3]Patch Notes Summary[/h3][color=Lightsteelblue][list]
[*] New player customization options.
[*] Improved card placement with large hands
[*] Added join/leave notification to lobby chat.
[*] Added noise on player join.
[*] New game modifiers: Hydra, Speed Loader, and Randomizer.
[*] Ricochet has a chance to miss again and will properly display when it does.
[*] Avarice and Holder now activate when shot at if it wasn't a lethal shot.
[*] The first turn of a round is only randomized for the first round.
[*] Fixed hype music volume not being affected by game settings.
[*] Fixed infinite credit bug. [i](This was only a visual error, no credits were actually gained.)[/i]
[*] Fixed an issue where more cards were being dealt with than intended. [i](You should only receive a card when you become the target of an attack. Previously if a bullet bounced off of someone else and on to you, that was also dealing out a card. So if multiple Ricochet cards were in play a lot of cards were being dealt instead of just one to the original target.)[/i]
[/list][/color]

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0 — Rolling into Town June 27
notes.notes:
[img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2858790/extras/DMH_Border.png?t=1716600008[/img]

Howdy, y’all!

Tapkeeper here along with the team at DEAD MAN’S HAND Saloon bringin’ you exciting news straight from the Wild Frontier.

First and foremost, we know you fine folks love a good wager, so we’re bettin’ you’ll like this news: players can now use their Frontier Credits in a number of new ways! Some of you already noticed you can place bounties on surviving players after you’ve been eliminated, but those divine minds at the HEAVEN CORPORATION are rollin’ out something new! Keep on reading to find out more.

[h2]Character Customization — Coloring the Wild Frontier[/h2]

Starting in the 1.1.0 Colorful Frontier update, patrons can use their hard earned Frontier Credits to purchase new colors for their frontier units! Whether it’s the clothes, the hair, or even the body, our good friends at the HEAVEN CORPORATION are sparing no expense to let your favorite automatons roll out in style! Ever wanted to see Saloongirl in a blue ensemble? Or maybe the Lawman needs a bit more silver in his mustache? These and more are at your command. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44918709/f03e45b09cec270025fd219956d354f77161d314.png[/img]

Of course, all patrons will have access to a handful of extra color options right away, so feel free to start gettin’ all dolled up for the occasion as soon as the patch drops.

To usher in this new era of Wild Frontier Fashion, we’ve also got a new menu for character customization. Just select the CUSTOMIZE option from the main menu. From there you’ll be able to set your character and colors along with your name and motto. The colors you unlock along the way will be added to your drop down options, with additional colors being added as time ticks along.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44918709/a039ef6241aca76bc2964f26d13895f377801320.png[/img]

[h2]New Game Type: Hydra Mode[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44918709/f2486d193f2ac12934812fc8f549f8c28ad08563.png[/img]

A handful of players have expressed interest in seeing a game type where you can get your head blown off once or twice but still be in the game. We're happy to share that you've got your wish.

Coming in Patch 1.1.0, we've added what we call Hydra Mode— when you blow away one head, another one moves into its place. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44918709/da8afdc1181bab02f6e0195e6c58baadbe8a1f6e.png[/img]

Players will be able to activate this mode in the pre-game lobby. This mode will grant each player 3 lives. Just heed this word of warning- Hydra Mode is not to be used lightly in games featuring more than just two players. Matches last much, much longer once the Hydra Mode is in play, so prepare accordingly before you jump in.

[h2]Exclusive Rewards for Play Testers and Frontier Pioneers
[/h2]

Last but certainly not least, we want to give a very special thank you to those fine patrons who stepped up to the DEAD MAN’S HAND Saloon when she first began to open her doors. Venturing out into unknown lands is always risky, but those of you who rose to the challenge have made all the difference for us folks here in Heavenside. That’s why we want to show our appreciation with somethin’ special just for you.

Firstly, all patrons who have registered the game to their account prior to the release of patch 1.1.0 will receive an exclusive color for their frontier units. This bonus will automatically be applied to all accounts who own the game prior to the launch of patch 1.1.0, so be sure to snag it before it’s too late if you want to reap the reward. That's June 27th, for those still on the fence.

As an additional thank you to those who not only picked up DEAD MAN’S HAND after its launch but also those who participated in our testing periods, our beta testers will be receiving an additional exclusive as well in the future, so please keep an eye out for correspondence from our team in the near future.

[img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2858790/extras/CRA_Border.png?t=1716600008[/img]

That's all for this edition of Wild Frontier news. Once again, we offer our most heartfelt thanks to everyone who has purchased DEAD MAN'S HAND: Card Roulette Action. We have even more exciting content coming in the future, and that includes special features we're saving for when the player population grows to certain numbers. If you enjoy the game, tell a friend, or even better, buy them a copy.

[i]—Management, DEAD MAN'S HAND Saloon 
[/i]
